expect: premise false: deformations beyond 10% were not performed, to avoid delamination of the coating (p6.L99-100)
question: Why did the authors strain the NiTi wires beyond 10%?
rendered: The authors strained the NiTi wires beyond 10% to ensure that the applied strain was sufficient to impose a compressive strain of about 1% on the metal oxide films, which is necessary to achieve the desired modulation of electrochemical intercalation potentials and diffusion coefficients.
